mapper.insert: INSERT INTO asset_snapshot (user_id, snapshot_date, category, total_amount, target_ratio, actual_ratio, balance_fund, sub_detail, is_latest, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{snapshotDate}, #{category}, #{totalAmount}, #{targetRatio}, #{actualRatio}, #{balanceFund}, #{subDetail}, true, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (user_id, snapshot_date, category, is_latest) DO UPDATE SET total_amount = EXCLUDED.total_amount, target_ratio = EXCLUDED.target_ratio, actual_ratio = EXCLUDED.actual_ratio, balance_fund = EXCLUDED.balance_fund, sub_detail = EXCLUDED.sub_detail, is_latest = true, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
